name: Yuri no Hana Natsu Monogatari ~Amanogawa no Kirameki o Kimi to~
original_name: 百合の花夏物語 ～天の川のキラめきを君と～
source:
Beautiful girl Kira entered an all girls school.
At the park among equally beautiful girls her head spun.
Amid the hubbub a lone girl joined her.
They fast became friends, attending summer school together. The winds of love blew gently upon them... 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE081052.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
美丽少女东キィラ进入了一所女子学校。
公园里到处都是同样漂亮的女孩，令她目不暇接。
喧闹人群中，一名独自行动的少女来到她身边。
两人很快成为朋友，一起参加暑期学校。爱情的微风也轻轻拂过她们……

[译自 [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE081052.html]DLsite English[/url]]
